input_contract.population: Adults presenting with suspected acute ischemic stroke, imaged with NCCT/CTA/CTP.

quality_constraints.imaging: Skull-stripped, co-registered volumes at the ISLES'24 spacing contract.

safety.disclaimer: No model artifact is registered. This entry exists to show the coverage gap and must never produce a finding.
limitations: DEFERRED. Blocked on ISLES'24 access (grand-challenge.org registration and DUA, a manual human step) and on disk: 5.9 GB free as of 2026-08-29.

Planned reused implementation: DeepISLES (github.com/ezequieldlrosa/DeepIsles) as the reference segmentation ensemble, nnU-Net (github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nnUNet) as the retraining fallback, MONAI (github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAI) for volume I/O, transforms, and Dice/IoU metrics.
DeepISLES code license and model-weight license are separate and both unverified; weights may inherit ISLES data terms.
Segmentation stays classical. Any quantum component would sit only on a compact fused image/clinical representation.

model_card.intended_use: Planned: acute ischemic lesion segmentation and infarct-core volume estimation from presentation CT/CTA/CTP.
model_card.evaluation_population: Planned: ISLES'24 held-out centre plus an external cohort.
model_card.label_policy: Expert lesion annotation and/or follow-up diffusion MRI.
data_licenses: ISLES'24 DUA — not accepted, access not obtained
model_card.explanation_method: planned: lesion mask overlay + per-region volume

reuse_manifest.license: permissive (unverified); weight license separate and unverified
reuse_manifest.preprocessing_assumptions: ISLES'24 modality set, spacing, and skull-stripping contract
